sidebar.emptyTitle: No schools match the current map view
sidebar.emptyHint: Zoom out or adjust the filters
sidebar.listTruncated: Showing the first {shown} of {total} — zoom in or filter to narrow it down

details.title: School details
details.legacyCaveat: Imported from an earlier dataset with an opaque methodology. It covers only ~8% of Australian schools and is missing for entire states, so it cannot be compared across schools or regions. Not an ACARA or national ranking.
details.icseaHint: Socio-educational advantage (an input), not an academic result

catchment.title: Intake zone
catchment.overlapNote: More than one zone can cover the same address. Boys' and girls' high schools serve the same area, and a senior campus can cover Years 11–12 on top of a Years 7–12 school.
catchment.nonGovernment: Non-government schools have no geographic intake zone. They admit on their own criteria — parish, siblings, or an entrance exam.
catchment.notPublished: No intake zone published for this school.
catchment.disclaimer: Zones change, and boundaries can split a single street. This is a guide, not a legal entitlement — the {state} education department accepts no responsibility where this data informs a property decision. Confirm the address on the official finder.
catchment.loadError: Could not load the zone boundary.
catchment.statesOnly: Intake zone data currently covers {states} government schools.
catchment.notPublishedAtPoint: No {state} government intake zone is published for this point.
catchment.partialSchool: {state} publishes zones for only some government schools. No boundary is published for this school. Unzoned schools use the unzoned school closest by road, and the department does not publish that boundary. Check the address on the official tool.
catchment.partialAtPoint: {state} publishes zones for only some government schools. This point may instead be assigned to the unzoned school closest by road; the department does not publish that boundary. Check the address on the official tool.

lookup.hint: Click anywhere on the map to see the schools zoned for that location
lookup.title: Zoned for this location
lookup.noResults: No published intake zone covers this point.

zoneBrowse.label: Zone borders
zoneBrowse.tooMany: {count} zones in view — zoom in to draw them
zoneBrowse.none: No published zones in this view
zoneBrowse.saPrimaryPartial: In South Australia, only some primary schools have formal zones. Blank areas use the closest unzoned school by road.
zoneBrowse.hint: One kind at a time: overlapping primary and secondary borders are difficult to distinguish.

legend.clusterRing: Ring = several schools, sliced by sector

directory.heading: School directory
directory.hint: Profiles, catchment zones and suburb pages for all of Australia.

dataNotice.title: ACARA canonical base
dataNotice.body: Map and list use official ACARA {year} public school profile and location data. Marker colour = sector, size = enrolments — both official ACARA fields.

shell.footerData: School identity, location and profile data comes from the ACARA Data Access Program. Official catchment source links appear below when this page uses boundary data.
shell.footerStance: Every figure on BetterSchool.au names its source. Where a value is inferred rather than official, the page says so; where it is not collected, the page says that too rather than showing a blank.

browse.metaTitle: Browse Australian schools by state and suburb
browse.metaDescription: Browse all {schools} Australian schools by state and suburb, with school zone and catchment maps for {states}.
browse.heading: Browse Australian schools
browse.intro: {schools} schools across {suburbs} suburbs, from the official ACARA {year} collection. Pick a state to see its suburbs, or go straight to the map to search by address.
browse.zonesBody: Zone boundaries currently cover NSW government schools only. Zones apply to government schools alone — Catholic and Independent schools admit on their own criteria and have no geographic zone. Other states are not yet collected, which is different from having none.
browse.largestHint: A shortcut into the biggest suburb pages. Every suburb is reachable through its state above.
browse.rankingsHint: VCE results where VCAA publishes them; ICSEA, which describes students' background, for every school type.

stateIndex.metaDescription: Every suburb in {state} with a school — {schools} schools across {suburbs} suburbs, from the official ACARA {year} collection.
stateIndex.heading: Schools in {state}, by suburb
stateIndex.zonedNote: {count} government schools in {state} publish an intake zone. A zone is set by address, and boundaries can run through the middle of a street — check the address itself rather than the suburb.
stateIndex.notCollectedNote: Intake zone boundaries are not collected for {state} yet — which is not the same as saying its government schools have none.
stateIndex.rankingsHint: VCE results where VCAA publishes them; ICSEA, which describes students' background rather than school performance, for every school type. Each ranking names its group and data year.

suburb.metaDescription: {count} schools in {suburb}, {state}. Official ACARA profiles with sector, size and year levels.
suburb.metaDescriptionOne: {count} school in {suburb}, {state}. Official ACARA profile with sector, size and year levels.
suburb.heading: Schools in {suburb}, {state}
suburb.zonesOtherState: Intake zone data currently covers {states}, so none is shown for {state}.
suburb.zonesPresent: {count} government schools in {suburb} publish an intake zone. A zone is the area whose residents get a guaranteed place — it is set by address, and boundaries can run through the middle of a street, so check your own address rather than the suburb.
suburb.zonesPresentOne: {count} government school in {suburb} publishes an intake zone. A zone is the area whose residents get a guaranteed place — it is set by address, and boundaries can run through the middle of a street, so check your own address rather than the suburb.
suburb.zonesNone: No government school based in {suburb} publishes an intake zone. That does not mean the suburb is unzoned — it is very likely inside the zone of a school based elsewhere.
suburb.zonesNoneCta: Look up a specific address on the map
suburb.relatedHint: Closest suburbs to {suburb}, by straight-line distance.
suburb.zonesNonePartial: No government school based in {suburb} publishes an intake zone. {state} zones only part of its government system, so this says little either way — the suburb may still sit inside the zone of a school based elsewhere.
suburb.compareNote: Sorted by ICSEA, highest first. ICSEA describes the socio-educational background of a school's students, not how the school performs. ACARA {year} data; students per teacher calculated by BetterSchool.

school.metaDescription: {sector} {type} school in {suburb}, {state}. Official ACARA profile, enrolment and location data.
school.profileSource: From the ACARA Data Access Program, {year} collection.
school.icseaNote: Index of Community Socio-Educational Advantage: it describes the socio-educational background of the students, not how the school performs.
school.fieldLbote: Language other than English at home
school.religionFromSector: Derived from the official ACARA sector.
school.religionInferredBody: Inferred from the school's governing body — not an official ACARA field.
school.religionInferredName: Inferred from the school's name — not an official ACARA field.
school.religionUnknownNote: Not determined. Left Unknown rather than guessed.
school.feesFreeNote: Government school. Voluntary contributions may still apply.
school.feesNotCollectedNote: We publish a fee only with a dated source. Nothing is estimated.
school.zoneNonGovernment: Non-government schools have no geographic intake zone. They admit on their own criteria — parish, siblings, or an entrance exam.
school.zoneNotPublished: No intake zone is published for this school.
school.zoneOtherState: Intake zone data currently covers {states}, so none is shown for {state}.
school.nearbyHint: Closest schools outside {suburb}, by straight-line distance. A suburb boundary is an administrative line, not the limit of what your child can attend.
school.naplanBody: ACARA publishes this school's NAPLAN results on My School. The link at the top of the page opens its official page.
school.zonePartialState: {state} publishes intake zones for only some of its government schools, and the published data does not say which rule decides. None is published for this school — that is not the same as this school having no zone.
school.metaDescriptionFull: {sector} {type} school in {suburb}, {state}: {years}, {count} students. Year-by-year enrolments, staffing, intake zone and nearby schools from official ACARA data.
school.lead: {school} is a {type} school in {suburb}, {state}, in the {sector} sector. It teaches {years} to {count} students (ACARA, {year}).
school.leadBasic: {school} is a {type} school in {suburb}, {state}, in the {sector} sector. ACARA publishes no {year} profile for it, so enrolment and staffing figures are left out here rather than estimated.
school.statRatioNote: {teachers} teachers (FTE). Calculated from ACARA figures: a school-wide average, not a class size.
school.hlSpecial: Classified by ACARA as a special school rather than a general-intake school.
school.hlOnlySectorInSuburb: The only {sector} school among the {total} schools in {suburb}.
school.hlEntryYear: Year {year} is a major entry point: {count} students, against {previous} in the year below.
school.hlLarge: Large for its kind: more students than {percent}% of the {pool} {type} schools in {state}.
school.hlSmall: Small for its kind: fewer students than {percent}% of the {pool} {type} schools in {state}.
school.hlRemote: ACARA classifies this location as Remote.
school.hlVeryRemote: ACARA classifies this location as Very Remote.
school.hlLbote: {percent}% of students have a language background other than English.
school.hlMultiCampus: ACARA lists this as the head campus of a multi-campus school.
school.cohortSource: ACARA Enrolments by Grade, {year} — one bar for each year level the school offers.
school.cohortUnpublished: A dash marks a year level the school offers but ACARA publishes no count for.
school.cohortPreNote: Pre is the year two before Year 1 — preschool or kindergarten, depending on the state.
school.seaNote: Share of this school's students in each national quarter. An intake that mirrored the country would put 25% in each.
school.diagramTitle: Schools near {school}, by direction and distance
school.diagramCaption: The {count} nearest schools by straight-line distance. North is up and the rings are {step} km apart. Dot size follows enrolments and colour follows sector, the same key as the map.
school.diagramZone: The outline is this school's published intake zone.
school.compareIntroNearby: Nearby: the {count} nearest {type} schools within {km} km, of any sector.
school.compareIntroState: State: every {type} school in {state} with a published figure.
school.compareSource: ACARA {year} data; ranks and percentages calculated by BetterSchool.
school.compareRankingLink: Full ranking of {group} in {state} by ICSEA
school.y12Rank: {rank} of {count} Victorian schools by median VCE study score in {year}, among schools with at least {min} VCE students.
school.y12Small: Fewer than {min} VCE students in {year}, where a handful of results moves the median, so this school is not ranked by default.
school.y12Withheld: — means VCAA did not publish the figure: fewer than four students, or the program is not offered.
school.y12Source: VCAA Senior Secondary Completion and Achievement Information. © Victorian Curriculum and Assessment Authority.
school.y12EarlyOnly: No student completed the VCE here in {year}: these results come from students taking Units 3–4 studies early, before the school has a Year 12, so it is not ranked.

catchment.metaDescription: The published intake zone for {school}, {suburb} {state}. Official department boundary, checked against the department’s own address tool.
catchment.heading: {school} catchment area
catchment.seeOnMap: See the zone on the map
catchment.checkBody: A {state} public school reserves places for children living in its intake zone. Zones change as schools open, close and fill, and a boundary can run through the middle of a street — so an address near an edge has to be checked, not assumed. The department publishes the authoritative tool.
catchment.schoolFinderLink: Confirm an address with the {state} education department
catchment.insideHint: Schools whose own address falls within the boundary — including non-government schools, which do not use zones themselves but are an option for families living here.
catchment.insideSuburbsCaveat: These are the suburbs of the schools inside the boundary, which is a sample of the area rather than a list of every suburb the zone touches.
catchment.insideNone: No other geocoded schools were found inside this published boundary.
catchment.zoneYearsUnknown: Year levels not published per zone

ranking.metaDescription: The {shown} {group} in {state} with the highest ICSEA, out of {ranked} with a published figure. Official ACARA {year} data, with enrolments and students per teacher for each school.
ranking.heading: {group} in {state}, ranked by ICSEA
ranking.introTop: {ranked} {group} in {state} have a published ICSEA. The top {shown} are listed here; every school's own page shows where it sits in the state.
ranking.introAll: {ranked} {group} in {state} have a published ICSEA, and all of them are listed here.
ranking.unranked: {count} more have no published ICSEA and are not ranked.
ranking.method: Ranked by ICSEA, highest first, among {group} in {state} with a published figure; tied values share a rank. ICSEA describes the socio-educational background of a school's students, not how the school performs. ACARA {year} data; students per teacher calculated by BetterSchool.
ranking.naplan: NAPLAN results are published school by school on {link}.
ranking.otherStatesHeading: The same ranking in other states
ranking.metaTitleVce: Best {group} in {state} {year}: ranked by VCE median study score
ranking.metaDescriptionVce: {ranked} {group} in {state} ranked by their {year} median VCE study score and share of study scores of 40 and over, from official VCAA data, with ICSEA, enrolments and students per teacher. Sort by any column or set your own weights.
ranking.introVce: {ranked} {group} in {state} published a median VCE study score for {year} and had at least {min} VCE students. Click a column to re-sort, or weight the columns yourself.
ranking.smallCohort: {count} more had fewer than {min} VCE students, where a handful of results moves the median, and are hidden by default.
ranking.includeSmall: Include schools with fewer than {min} VCE students
ranking.methodVce: Default order: median VCE study score, highest first; schools on the same median are separated by their share of study scores of 40 and over. VCE results: VCAA Senior Secondary Completion and Achievement Information {year}, © Victorian Curriculum and Assessment Authority. ICSEA, enrolments and staff: ACARA {acaraYear}; students per teacher calculated by BetterSchool. Campuses that report VCE results separately are listed separately, and a campus without its own ACARA profile shows no ICSEA.
ranking.weightsHint: Each weight applies to a school's percentile on that figure within this table. Only schools with every weighted figure take part: {count} here.
ranking.earlyOnly: {count} schools that have not yet reached Year 12 also published a median, from students taking Units 3–4 studies early; they are not ranked.
